# Adithya Rajendran

> M.S. Engineering student in robotics and AI at SJSU, formerly a Field Software Engineer at Canonical. Notes on infrastructure and robotic vision.

## Writing

- [A Homelab Built to Be Rebuilt](https://adithya-rajendran.com/blog/my-homelab): How three Raspberry Pis, an old Dell laptop, and three mini PCs bootstrap my OpenStack lab.
- [Running GUI Apps in LXD Containers](https://adithya-rajendran.com/blog/running-gui-apps-in-lxc-containers): The LXD profile I use to run GUI tools on my Linux desktop.
- [Sharing the DGX Spark GPU with MicroK8s](https://adithya-rajendran.com/blog/kubernetes-on-the-nvidia-dgx-spark): Setting up MicroK8s, the NVIDIA GPU Operator, and GPU time-slicing on my DGX Spark.

## Projects

- [Homelab with segmented networks and high availability](https://adithya-rajendran.com/portfolio/homelab): PXE bare-metal provisioning, segmented networking, and storage outside the cluster so it can be wiped and redeployed.
- [Kubernetes cluster with NFS and OIDC](https://adithya-rajendran.com/portfolio/kubernetes-cluster): A highly available three-node Kubernetes cluster with zero downtime during upgrades and maintenance.
- [Gmail filter with an experimental spam classifier](https://adithya-rajendran.com/portfolio/gmail-spam-filter): Built with a student team in 2022, extended in 2025 with a TF-IDF and multilayer-perceptron spam classifier trained on the CEAS-08 corpus.
